ledger.label: Ad budgets never went dark
ledger.detail: The +180% cap was reached at hour 62 and pacing throttled at the mROAS floor rather than at the budget. Last year’s ten dark hours cost $12K; this year cost nothing.

ledger.label: Air freight was correctly priced
ledger.detail: $3.1K bought zero stockouts with 4.2 hours of margin on the closest SKU. Keep the T-4 cover-against-forecast check; it is what found the gap.

ledger.label: Creative capacity is the recurring constraint
ledger.detail: Third event running where DTC assets arrive late. The fix is a T-14 creative gate, not a bigger rush budget — annotated for next year’s T-8 card.

ledger.label: Cover, not demand, is the P90 constraint
ledger.detail: At hour 62 the model was tracking toward P90 and inventory could not follow. Next year’s buy should be sized against P75, not P50.

execution.ledger_note: Expires Aug 27 at 06:00 — 82 hours from now. No renewal path; a second event needs a second signature.
execution.arming: 3 actions taken without asking, every one inside a bound written four days ago. 2 sit here because they are outside a bound or outside the math — cannibalisation and customer experience are not bounded quantities.
